author: Cleo Abram
description:
This surgery robot is cutting open and stitching back up… corn. And it could one day save your life.

This tiny surgery is controlled by HUMAN doctors watching through a magnified camera. The robot helps take the doctor’s movements but scale them down into smaller, more precise ones, meaning it could one day operate on blood vessels or nerves, helping reattach limbs or fix nerve damage.

For more optimistic science and tech stories subscribe! 

#science #surgery #robot #doctor #medicine
title: This Microrobot Does Tiny Surgeries
